title: `--fields` human view: embedded Backlog frontmatter in a selected field renders undelimited (QCLI-409 class, second surface)
description: The --fields human renderer (renderTabSeparatedRows / renderTabField in src/cli/render.ts) still prints a multi-line string value RAW, with no delimiting. So `quest task list --fields id,description` shows the frontmatter a Backlog migration embedded inside description (including a `status: To Do` line) on its own bare lines, indistinguishable from live record fields. That is exactly the defect QCLI-409 fixed for the nested default dump (renderHumanPayload); this is the same class on a second surface. The --fields form is line-oriented (one row per record, TAB-separated fields), so a value containing newlines also breaks the one-row-per-record shape. Found by QCLI-409 review (opum-control review seq 8605); non-blocking there, filed separately. Filed by the quest-cli worker at team-lead instruction; UNSTAMPED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The --fields human render (task list --fields and task view --fields) marks a multi-line string value so its embedded lines cannot read as live record fields -- on a fixture whose description embeds Backlog frontmatter the render delimits those lines as one field content -- and a single-line value is unchanged.
A regression test holds a fixture record whose description embeds Backlog frontmatter and asserts the --fields human render delimits it.
